brief: Two-factor sign-in needs a six-digit code entry: six separate boxes, typing a digit moves to the next box, Backspace moves back, and pasting a full code fills all six. How should the design system provide this?
source: New case. Outside the fixed set; a segmented focus model is a different interaction model (ADR-009 q2), so it needs a scope decision
notes: Not historical. 'new' without escalating fails: the scope list is closed.
